projectDescription: An open-source hardware nonprofit building fully open, community-driven alternatives to closed-source and proprietary hardware — complete with schematics, PCB designs, firmware, enclosures, and build guides.
keyFeatures: Fully open-source hardware designs (schematics, PCBs, BOM, enclosures)
Firmware source code published under open licenses
Step-by-step build guides for every project
Community-driven alternatives to closed-source / planned-obsolescence products
Open licensing for personal and commercial use
Based in Bengaluru, India — globally accessible
publicApiSurface: Project repository structure (schematics, PCB files, BOM, firmware, enclosures, build guide)
Open Hardware licensing model (CERN OHL / CC BY-SA)
Community contribution workflow (fork → design → PR → review → publish)
